scope: All 156 model labels, tip sets, unrooted edge sets, checkpoint/report likelihood agreement, checkpoint/tree branch lengths, version-specific eight-iteration empirical frequencies, gamma-category means and AIC/BIC arithmetic checked. Warnings and short edges retained. Not an independent likelihood recomputation, convergence proof, model-adequacy test or ancestral reconstruction.
diagnostic_export_note: warnings.tsv deliberately retains lines matching failed, including summaries reporting zero composition failures. The original fits_with_warning_lines count is a diagnostic-line count, not evidence every fit has an actual warning or failed.
